title: A 3-V 340-mW 14-b 75-Msample/s CMOS ADC With 85-dB SFDR at Nyquist Input
figure_number: Fig. 2. THA architectures. (a) Charge-redistribution THA. (b) Flip-around THA.
function_summary: 3-V 340-mW 14-b 75-Msample/s CMOS ADC: The ADC uses a 4-b first stage to relax capacitor-matching requirements, buffered bootstrapping to reduce signal-dependent charge injection, and a flip-around track-and-hold amplifier with wide common-mode compliance to reduce noise and power consumption.
